events.description: A man in a camouflage shirt is holding another man by the neck/shoulders and appears to be dragging or forcing him forward while raising a pistol; the second man is bent over, seemingly subdued and helpless.

A man in the foreground points a pistol directly at a man in a beige shirt who stands with hands raised; multiple armed soldiers are present and aiming weapons, indicating an active armed confrontation with imminent or ongoing gunfire.

The man in the camouflage shirt holds a pistol aloft in his right hand while standing over a subdued individual; the posture and weapon orientation suggest he has just fired or is threatening to fire.
A large, violent explosion erupts from a structure, producing a bright flash, rapidly expanding fireball, and high-velocity debris fragmentation; visible in frames f1 through f7.

At least two individuals are visibly holding and aiming firearms during the explosion; muzzle flashes or bullet trajectories are not clearly resolved, but weapon posture and context strongly indicate active shooting concurrent with the blast (frames f2–f3).

Multiple armed individuals are engaged in close-quarters combat amid the explosion; one figure appears to be lunging or striking while others aim weapons—suggesting mutual aggressive engagement rather than unilateral attack (frames f2–f3).

A rapid structural collapse of a wooden roof/ceiling occurs amid intense fire, with visible outward blast effects (debris ejection, sudden smoke surge) and near-instantaneous failure—consistent with a secondary explosion or fire-induced detonation rather than gradual burn-through. Frames f0–f5 show the progression from initial fire intensification to full implosion and debris dispersal.
A sudden, bright flash and rapid expansion of fire and smoke erupts from the ground near the building's right side, consistent with a detonation event.

Two soldiers in uniform are engaged in close physical struggle on the ground amid debris and fire; one is on top of the other, pushing down, while both are actively resisting and moving—indicating mutual combat rather than one-sided subduing.
A sudden bright flash and expanding fireball erupts in the background behind the soldiers, consistent with a nearby explosion; debris is visibly displaced and smoke intensifies abruptly.

Two soldiers are engaged in close physical struggle on the ground: one is on top, pressing down, while the other is pinned beneath; their postures and contact suggest active grappling rather than collapse or assistance.
A large explosion occurs in the background, sending debris and smoke into the air; visible in frames f0–f6 as a sudden blast with flying fragments and rising smoke plume.

A man (Tom Hanks) is engaged in close-quarters physical combat: he swings a machete-like weapon downward while crouching, suggesting an active strike against an opponent just out of frame; motion and posture indicate mutual or aggressive engagement.
